correctness.rationale: Equation (1) follows from exhaustive order-ideal encoding. A two-step recurrence gives induced-edge equality and vertex coverage, and connectivity forces either the bipartition case or the complementary two-edge-cover case. Wheels are nonbipartite and their named edge bicolourings are counted exactly by a 2-by-2 matrix with eigenvalues 3,-1 and a Lucas exclusion. Independent exhaustive ideal and edge-colouring programs agree for rim sizes 3 through 8, while the edge-colouring program continues through 10 and validates connected graphs of size up to four.

value.rationale: The all-graph correspondence translates a naturally defined short periodic orbit classification into graph edge-cover decompositions, rather than merely rephrasing a known color count. For every wheel it gives a complete explicit sequence with a Lucas correction and base-three exponential growth. This exactly answers a natural finite-poset dynamical invariant over an infinite graph family; more than a normalization or isolated small-instance computation, without pretending to solve longer-orbit classification.
